notes.title: Minor Update 🚀 1.0.5
notes.content:
After a week of work travel, I am back with a minor update for Astrodle. This update is in line with previous updates, with small changes aimed at addressing issues reported in the discussions forum, here on Steam.

This update includes the following modifications:
[list]
[*] [b]Travel[/b]: I wasn't able to reproduce the bug where sometimes upgrades won't unlock after the first travel unless one saves and restarts the game. I have added more fail-safes in the code to hopefully reduce the chances of this happening.
[*] [b]Empty space (mission)[/b]: the game is now better at tracking the number of blobs remaining when they are all destroyed at the same frame by the Detonator. This mission is still hard to do with this drone because of Duplicity and the fact that respawning blobs are invulnerable. A note has been added in the mission's description to highlight this constraint.
[*] [b]Annihilation (mission)[/b]: in Quest mode, the mission now displays the current capacity to hint at the fact that you don't have to complete this mission with 200 blobs (which is hard for the same reasons as Empty space).
[*] [b]Orbiter[/b]: the tooltip now correctly show the Orbiter and not the Chaser.
[*] [b]Settings[/b]: when accessed from the main menu, the tooltips now have an icon instead of a white square.
[/list]

Thanks for reading this patch notes.
Here's a cookie 🍪

Robin

notes.title: Minor update v1.0.4
notes.content:
The last few days have been awesome for Astrodle but there are still a few things that needed immediate attention before the weekend.

A big thank you for all the players who have taken the time to report these issues in the discussion forum.

This patch includes the following modifications:
[list]
[*] [b]Bullets[/b]: now limited to 300 bullets at any time to avoid feedback loops frying your computers. Additional bullets will simply not be generated. This should not affect the game in most situations.
[*] [b]Becoming a god[/b]: the game will now hint at what to do at the end of the story. This should prevent players from thinking the game has frozen and should be shut down.
[*] [b]Typos[/b]: several texts containing typos have been corrected.
[*] [b]Drones[/b]: the cockpit monitors now display the correct drone designations in the background (ex: G07 instead of A07 for the Gunner).
[*] [b]Settings[/b]: the "Mute" button is now called "Toggle all sound" to better reflect it's function.
[*] [b]How did we get here?[/b]: this mission will now display a warning in its description when its undoable because the current start doesn't have relevant stellar bonus.
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix v1.0.3
notes.content:
This patch fixes the following issue:
[list]
[*] [b]Libra blobs[/b]: are no longer immortal.
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix v1.0.2
notes.content:
This patch fixes several issues:
[list]
[*] [b]Gunner[/b]: bullets are not automatically destroyed when loading the second game mode, after having traveled to another star in the first game mode in the same session.
[*] [b]Hello?[/b]: the mission is no longer undoable after [b]On the way[/b] has been completed.
[*] [b]Aquarius blobs[/b]: the essence obtained when destroying Aquarius blobs is now correctly overridden by the Chaser's Blade and Critical bullets.
[*] [b]Dialogue[/b]: when the game loads a save. It will considered dialogues that have been started but not "skipped" nor "finished" as "skipped". This will prevent issues that may arise when closing the game during a dialogue. Old messages can always be replayed from the phone interface.
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix v1.0.1
notes.content:
This patch fixes two issues with missions:
[list]
[*] [b]On the way[/b]: fixed an issue where the internal memory of the Target wasn't properly reset when withdrawn, only after it had travelled more than one orbit.
[*] [b]Annihilation[/b]: changed the wording of the mission to better explain the task at hand.
[list]
[*] From: Detonate the Detonator and destroy all the Blobs in orbit at once.
[*] To: Detonate the Detonator and destroy as many Blobs as the current Orbital Capacity.
[/list]
[/list]

notes.title: Next Fest Update
notes.content:
Hi godlings! 

The June Next Fest is [b]next week[/b] and Astrodle is participating. This means it's a good time to update the demo with some fixes and QOL changes.

You have been 850 to play the demo so far, for a total number of 1700 hours played! [b]Thank you so much[/b] for the interest you have shown in the game.

As you may have noticed, the release date on the store page reads "June 2024". That means Astrodle is coming real soon!

I will announce the [b]release date[/b] in a few days, so keep reading this announcements!

Robin

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3003440/Astrodle_Demo

[h2]Demo Changelog[/h2]
[h3]Major changes[/h3]
[list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895048/cd75f097a02fb66fd7694962f0ffbd3f5bea4f59.gif[/img]
[*] [b]Gunner[/b]: the velocity bonus is now only applied once the drone is ready to fire. The base velocity has been reduced and the bonuses from upgrades have been increased.
[list]
[*] This will prevent the gunner from zooming past a target right before it's ready to shoot.
[*] This will make the velocity upgrades more useful in early game.
[*] The initial velocity has been reduced by 34%.
[*] Upgrades increase velocity by [strike]35%[/strike] → 50% each.
[*] Upgrades cost [strike]25/.../18,000[/strike] → 15/.../15,000.
[*] A new visual effect is applied to the gunner when the bonus is active.
[*] A new visual element shows the drone loading the next shot.
[/list][/list]
[h3]Minor changes[/h3]
[list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895048/1fcf0830977e2c15e1b291624a6d8a320e0bd17b.png[/img]
[*] [b]Missions[/b]: secret code missions are now unlocked after the column above has been completed since they cannot be completed before that.
[list]
[*] This only affects players who have not unlocked these missions yet.
[*] To emphasize their difference, they have a different color and description than the regular missions when locked.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895048/8b4b48dadc51baae60f3d6faed9020226859883b.gif[/img]
[*] [b]Travel[/b]: new visual effects have been added to help understand when traveling has been unlocked and when new objectives have been reached.
[list]
[*] Unlocking traveling after Taurus's dialogue will now trigger a full animation with a distinctive sound effect.
[*] Reaching an essence objectives will now play a similar visual effect with text that emphasizes the doubling of the essence on the next star. This effect also happens within the travel UI when this one is opened.
[/list][/list]
[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Bullets[/b]: are now correctly destroyed when traveling to another star. This didn't much impact on the demo as bullets are short-lived in it.
[*] [b]Gunner[/b]: will not sometimes fire twice in a row after an upgrade.
[*] [b]Texts[/b]: some texts are now properly hyphenated. More to come in future patches.
[*] [b]Missions[/b]:
[list]
[*] Fixed the background arrows not having the right color in the mission interface
[*] [b]Dinner is served[/b]: "Gemini Blob" is now properly formatted in the mission description.
[*] [b]Grounded[/b]: rephrased the description to insist on releasing the chaser.
[/list][/list]
[h3]Version[/h3]
[list]
[*] Save format: [strike]0[/strike] → 1.
[/list]



Thanks for reading, here's a cookie 🍪

notes.title: Play the Demo! ♌
notes.content:
Indecisive about wishlisting Astrodle? Just play the demo already!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3003440/Astrodle_Demo

Starting now, the demo will serve as an introduction to Astrodle. It's basically the same game, except you are limited in your progression so that you will eventually hit a wall at around [b]45 to 60 minutes[/b] of play time, depending on your play style.

[h2]💾 Transferable save[/h2]
After you are finished playing the demo, your progress will be safe in the [b]Steam Cloud[/b]. When the game comes out, you will be able to resume your quest in the main game and finally become the god or goddess you deserve to be!

[h2]📆 Release Date[/h2]
If you like the demo, you won't have to wait for long! Astrodle will be released just a few days after the June 2024 Steam Next Fest. That's in just under four weeks 🙂

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895048/6d2050adb18c69fc05b7cce11688be42914d557b.png[/img]
Also there might be a magical waffle in the demo, but that's probably a hoax.

notes.title: Watch Astrodle's new trailer!
notes.content:
Astrodle has a new trailer! And an improved Store Page too.

Although the Store Page was put up a while ago to register Astrodle to [u][b]June's Next Fest[/b][/u], it wasn't in good shape. That's in the past now, the new page is here.

Better screenshots, GIFS, a trailer... I've been hard at work over the past month and we've got all the things now! So let's watch this trailer together:
[previewyoutube=7T1eARcTl8U;full][/previewyoutube]

Astrodle is a clicker/idle game in which you gather [b]lots of different resources[/b], called Zodiac Essences. These essences are the key to transcending your humanity and joining the Signs as one of their equals, as a space god.

As many other games of the genre, Astrodle is a number-fueled power fantasy. Start slow but be prepared to [b]drown in numbers[/b] as the game progresses. A late game of Astrodle is a festival of colorful numbers popping onto your screen and if you're anything like me… you'll find this extremely satisfying.

It's also on the shorter side of clicker games, with all the fun of the main story packed into [b]a weekend long experience[/b]. I don't like when idle games drag on forever and never let you go… so I wanted Astrodle to be mindful of that. However, I do have some plans to make the game longer for players who enjoy that!

Let me know if you liked the trailer and don't forget to [b]add the game to your wishlist[/b]!
